newsitem.title: USA: Kansas Republican Roberts takes heat for remark.
newsitem.headline: Kansas Republican Roberts takes heat for remark.

text.p: Democrats and women's groups blasted Kansas Republican senatorial candidate Pat Roberts on Monday for referring to his Democratic opponent as a "bitch."

Supporters of Democrat Sally Thompson held a rally on Sunday in a Kansas City suburb to publicise Roberts' remark. The incident occurred after a debate last Thursday at the offices of the Kansas City Star newspaper.

As the candidates were leaving, a reporter overheard Roberts refer to Thompson as a "bitch" in a conversation he was having with his son, David. Roberts noticed the reporter and quickly apologised, but the Star quoted the remark in a story the following day.

"I apologise to my opponent. I extend that apology to all others who may have taken offence," Roberts said in a statement released on Friday. "Such statements are out of line whether they are made in public or in private."

Eleanor Harris, president of the Kansas City Urban chapter of the National Organisation for Women, said Roberts' apology did not go far enough. "His apology seemed kind of weak," Harris told Reuters on Monday. "Some of the things he said seemed like he was trying to exonerate himself."
Roberts and Thompson were vying for the Senate seat being vacated by Nancy Kassebaum. Most polls have shown Roberts, a veteran U.S. congressman, leading Thompson by double digits.
